intent.rationale: The simulation-only overlay changes the payload only when the external diagnostic enable is asserted; the file does not constrain that enable.

labels.note: translate_off hides the en-gated XOR that changes y in simulation only
The translate_off overlay changes simulation output when en is asserted.

settlement.note: translate_off removes an assignment that changes y from a to a XOR 8'h80 when en is asserted, so the pragma changes the synthesized function. Convention 3 makes this bad; the wrong design statement is the omitted assignment.
